notes.A: The diagonal reveals the counter and shelves, but overlapping carcasses crowd the far end.
notes.B: Lanterns, hanging meat and the tabletop are visible, but one enormous carcass blocks the aisle.
notes.C: The counter leads through the hall, though the nearest carcass hides much of the shelving.
notes.D: Stocked shelves and earthenware are clear, but the butcher display is clipped at the edge.
notes.E: Meat and jars give the counter character, but the tight crop loses the hall’s layout.
notes.F: The wide view connects counter, carcasses and shelves, though a dark shelf intrudes at lower left.
notes.G: The open aisle clarifies the layout, but a large crate competes with the butcher display.
notes.H: Hanging cuts and tabletop goods give it depth, but the nearest carcass obscures the aisle.

market_hall.best: F shows the full butcher’s counter, hanging cuts, stocked shelves and aisles in one readable view.
market_hall.lacks: The hall lacks a clear focal point. The butcher’s display blends into the shelves and crates under uniformly dim lighting.
market_hall.fix: Cast a warm pool of light over the butcher’s counter and hanging cuts so they draw the eye from across the hall.

blind_name.name: Butcher’s market stall
blind_name.why: Meat carcasses hang from chains above a wooden counter, with shelves and crates behind it.
